system.description:
Funerary script spirals along the weapon, growing cold whenever it approaches a creature sustained beyond death.

The first successful Strike you make each round against a creature with the Undead or Unliving trait inflicts additional secondary essence damage.

The weapon inflicts 1d6 damage.

Inscribed onto a weapon.

On the sheet: Applied automatically on the damage card: the tier's essence on the first hit each round against a creature with the Undead or Unliving trait.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
